{"consolidated_memory":"## Message Redelivery Issues in worker/queue/consumer.py (3 separate occasions)

All three issues manifested the same way (duplicate message ids handled more than once) in the same component (worker/queue/consumer.py, background jobs side), with identical repro steps (kill the worker mid-batch and restart it). However, each had a distinct root cause, affected user population, fix, and measured outcome.

---

### Occasion 1: [2026-06-05] Missing Composite Index (c025-e2)
- **Affected users**: Users sitting in negative UTC offset
- **Root cause**: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix**: Added composite index and backfilled in batches
- **PR #3332** on branch fix/message-redelivery-3
- **Result**: Flaky test improved from 55 failures per 100 runs to zero
- **Note**: Same corner of code as earlier message redelivery work; context carried over

---

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-15] Clock Skew Between Hosts (c025-e6)
- **Affected users**: Clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- **Root cause**: Clock skew between two hosts
- **Fix**: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- **PR #6706** on branch fix/message-redelivery-7
- **Stack**: Python
- **Covering check**: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
- **Result**: Cold start latency dropped 96%, down to 351 ms

---

### Occasion 3: [2026-07-25] Mutable Default Argument (c025-e7)
- **Affected users**: Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- **Root cause**: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix**: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR #6807** on branch fix/message-redelivery-8
- **Stack**: Python
- **Covering check**: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
- **Result**: p99 latency fell from 7.5 s to 949 ms"}
